categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to clear pending bytes before writing and avoid throwing during destructor unwinding.
categories.rationale: Fixes `std::terminate` process crashes caused by `BufferedWriter` attempting to flush in an implicitly `noexcept` destructor during disk write failures. The PR ensures buffer write errors can be handled cleanly without re-attempting writes during exception unwinding.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block and undo file storage error handling in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents unclean node aborts when disk write failures occur while writing block and undo data. Explicitly calling `flush()` within try-catch blocks routes disk exhaustion errors into standard fatal error handling rather than terminating the process.
